name: Instrument
premise: Precise and tool-like. There is no pictorial mark at all — the identity is the wordmark plus a grid device, which is the register a developer audience trusts fastest and the one that survives being rendered at 16 pixels in a browser tab. Colour is near-monochrome: a cool slate carrying every surface and every text role, with exactly one functional blue for anything interactive. The discipline is the point. Nothing in this direction is decorative, and the risk it carries is that nothing in it is memorable either.

ground.label: Slate
ground.note: Deliberately almost achromatic. The chroma ceiling is held low by hand so the neutral never reads as a colour.

accent.label: Signal
accent.note: The one colour in the system. If something is this blue, it does something.

declared_duplicates.why: A rejected direction, kept as a record. Its line colour resolves to its body text colour in the light themes, which means a border carries the same weight as prose. Recorded rather than repaired: this is a property of the palette that was not chosen, and repairing it would misrepresent what was rejected.
